# AlchemyLab

AlchemyLab runs a fleet of coding agents against your project and keeps a record of what they did: every change is a request with a branch, tests, review and a merge you can read back.

## Install

Requires Node 22.16 or newer (not 23), or Node 24 and newer. Docker is optional; with it, tests and experiments run in sealed containers.

```
npm install -g alchemylab
```

## Start

Run it in the directory of the project you want to work on:

```
cd my-project
alchemy
```

The first run asks you to log in with your AlchemyLab account and opens the agent console. Keep it running; the web app talks to it.

## Work

Open the project at https://alchemylabcode.com and say what you want in plain words. The lead agent registers each ask as a request, hands it to a coder, and reports back in the same stream. Questions that need you show up there too.

## Commands

```
alchemy           start the local server and the agent console (default)
alchemy logout    forget the stored login
alchemy --help
```

## More

Documentation and help live inside the app under Help.
